tasks.note: All 15 acceptance criteria met. Its one blocking finding — three tests broken in src/renderer/src/__tests__/, which T4 was forbidden to touch — was NOT resolved by a revision round and is not open: escalation E2 reassigned the repair to T5 with the user approving a manifest amendment. revisionRounds stays 0 because T4 had nothing of its own to redo. redispatches is 1, from a reviewer that died on an API session limit before reading anything.

escalations.question: What shape should LaneRowVm take to carry the Pod status? renderer-state.ts is a frozen contract and this session changes it.

options.summary: A distinct nullable field podStatus: PodStatus | null, on a data-pod-status attribute mutually exclusive with data-status.
options.rationale: status: LaneStatus keeps its exact type; the two vocabularies never share an attribute, so no existing CSS rule and no existing querySelector("[data-status]") needs an edit.

options.summary: Widen status to LaneStatus | PodStatus — one field, one attribute.
options.rationale: Smaller interface, but both unions contain running and disagree about its meaning, so the selector would match a streaming Pod and a merely-unended lane alike. Disambiguating needs a second field anyway.

options.summary: A pre-resolved presentation field carrying vocabulary, value and label text.
options.rationale: Leaves the row purely mechanical, but puts label TEXT into the view model, which no other field in renderer-state.ts does — a new pattern introduced by a bugfix.

escalations.answer: Distinct nullable field: podStatus: PodStatus | null, rendered on a data-pod-status attribute mutually exclusive with data-status. The user chose it over widening status, on the evidence that both unions contain running and would collide in the existing CSS selector.

escalations.question: T4 breaks three passing tests in src/renderer/src/__tests__/ that no task owns. Who fixes them, and what do the replacements assert? manifest.json is frozen, so widening any ownership set needs sign-off.

options.summary: Widen T5 to own the two existing e2e files; update the three assertions to the Pod vocabulary keeping a positive pre-state anchor.
options.rationale: T5 is already the joined rail-and-tab e2e task and already depends on T3 and T4, so the files belong to its concern. Keeping a positive anchor is required because pod-stop.e2e.test.tsx:473-474 exists so the test cannot confuse the fix working with the row never having said Running, and relaunch.e2e.test.tsx:501 not.toContain(Running) becomes trivially true for free.

options.summary: Add a new T6 owning only those two files, leaving T5 as decomposed.
options.rationale: Keeps every frozen ownership set intact and makes the repair its own reviewable unit, at the cost of one more task and one more review cycle.

options.summary: Assert the data attribute rather than the visible word at the three sites.
options.rationale: More stable against future label changes and matches stopped-lane.test.tsx:129, but drops the user-visible-text check these e2e suites are built on.

escalations.answer: Widen T5 to own pod-stop.e2e.test.tsx and relaunch.e2e.test.tsx, and repair the assertions in the Pod vocabulary while keeping a positive pre-state anchor rather than deleting the failing lines. Amendment authored by dir-architect, not hand-patched.
